    "evidence": "out = out + \",\".join(str(cell) for cell in row) + \"\\n\"",
    "llm_reasoning": "In Python, strings are immutable. Repeatedly concatenating strings using the '+' operator inside a loop creates a new string object in each iteration, leading to O(n^2) time complexity and excessive memory allocation as the output grows.",
    "suggested_fix": "Collect the rows in a list and use \"\\n\".join() to join them all at once at the end, or use io.StringIO to build the string efficiently.",
